claims.claim_text: American Airlines has a conditional pre-order of up to 250 VX4 aircraft (with option for additional 100), and committed to make a pre-delivery payment to reserve delivery slots for the first 50 VX4 aircraft.

claims.claim_text: Marubeni made a pre-delivery payment in January 2023 to reserve delivery slots for the first 25 VX4 aircraft of its conditional pre-order of up to 200 aircraft.

claims.claim_text: Avolon (aircraft leasing) is a pre-order/partnership customer; through Avolon's VX4 placements, Japan Airlines, Gol, Gozen Holdings and AirAsia are also customers.

claims.claim_text: Vertical has partnered with Microsoft to create a Vertical Cloud to host aircraft data and provide aircraft equipment health monitoring and aftermarket services.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023, Vertical Aerospace had fourteen pending patent applications (four in UK, four in US, four in Europe, one in Japan, one in China) covering seven inventions related to vehicle configuration, propulsion systems, thermal management, and propeller arrangements.
claims.subject: evtl

claims.claim_text: Vertical has a UK manufacturing/assembly footprint: HQ in Bristol (R&D, ~35,000 sqft), flight test centre at Cotswold Airport (Kemble, ~56,000 sqft hangars), and Vertical Energy Centre at Avonmouth, Bristol (~15,000 sqft battery testing).
